title: subscription.items is a dict method, not the line items, in stripe-python before v15
symptoms: sub.items prints a bound method instead of a list object
cause: Before v15 StripeObject subclassed dict, so the attribute name items resolved to dict.items and shadowed the API field.
fix: Use bracket access for the field. On v15 and later sub.items returns the line items and key iteration moves to to_dict().
